title: Director of Operations
text:
**Salary:** 140,000-180,000

**Other Forms of Compensation:**

Our Passion is Food! 
 
At Bon Appetit Management Company we are committed to two things, great food and outstanding service! At Bon Appetit you won't find our managers referring to a corporate recipe book or our chefs microwaving the lunch special. We do not have standardized recipes or central commissaries, instead, our chefs and managers are expected to stay abreast of current culinary trends and bring cutting edge food into their cafes. We are a restaurant company that operates in contract food service. That means you will have the freedom to be creative, take risks, and truly shine. We are committed to our staff growing, trying new things, and learning all that they can. Our rapid growth and breadth of accounts translates into exciting opportunities for our people!

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Director of Operations serves as the senior on-site leader and primary client partner for a premier workplace hospitality program designed to deliver an exceptional employee experience through intentional service, elevated culinary offerings, and world-class hospitality. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for building the operation from the ground up, establishing a culture of excellence, and ensuring every aspect of the program reflects the standards of leading workplace environments.

As the face of the account, the Director of Operations will oversee all dining, hospitality, catering, retail, and workplace experience initiatives while serving as the trusted advisor to the client. This leader will drive operational performance, financial stewardship, team development, and strategic growth while ensuring a seamless experience across breakfast, lunch, dinner, micro-kitchens, and a robust catering program. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in premium corporate dining, luxury hospitality, fine dining, or high-end food service environments and possesses the executive presence, emotional intelligence, and business acumen necessary to lead a rapidly growing operation.

Responsibilities

 

* Serve as the primary client-facing leader and strategic partner, building trusted relationships through exceptional communication, responsiveness, and operational execution.
* Lead the overall account strategy and daily operations, ensuring alignment with client goals, employee expectations, and company objectives.
* Launch and scale a premium workplace hospitality program designed to support significant organizational growth.
* Oversee multiple service platforms, including cafés, catering, workplace hospitality, executive events, micro-kitchens, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Provide leadership and direction to Café Managers, culinary leadership, catering teams, and hospitality staff while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and service excellence.
* Establish and maintain hospitality standards that deliver a highly personalized, white-glove guest experience.
* Drive a culture of intentional hospitality where every interaction enhances the employee and guest experience.
* Partner closely with the Senior Executive Chef to develop innovative dining experiences, culinary programming, and hospitality activations.
* Oversee a significant catering operation, ensuring flawless execution of meetings, executive functions, company events, and VIP hospitality experiences.
* Manage all financial aspects of the account, including budgeting, forecasting, P&L performance, labor management, cost controls, and financial reporting.
* Analyze operational and financial performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead recruitment, succession planning, employee engagement, and talent development efforts across the operation.
* Conduct regular business reviews with client stakeholders and provide strategic recommendations to enhance service offerings and overall program performance.
* Establish operational systems, policies, procedures, and service standards that support long-term scalability.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, client requirements, food safety programs, workplace safety standards, and applicable regulations.
* Champion innovation through hospitality programming, employee activations, wellness initiatives, and unique dining experiences.
* Create a highly engaged, service-focused culture that attracts, develops, and retains top hospitality talent.
* Collaborate with regional and corporate leadership to support account growth, business objectives, and long-term client retention.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Hotel Management, Culinary Management, or related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* 8-12+ years of progressive leadership experience in premium corporate dining, luxury hospitality, upscale restaurants, hotels, workplace experience, or high-end food service environments.
* Proven success leading large-scale food service, hospitality, or workplace dining operations with significant client interaction and operational complexity.
* Strong financial acumen with extensive experience managing P&Ls, budgets, forecasting, labor models, and operational performance metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to build and grow high-performing teams through leadership, coaching, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Experience opening new operations, launching hospitality programs, or leading rapidly growing business environments.
* Strong background managing catering operations, executive dining programs, VIP events, and hospitality-driven service models.
* Exceptional client relationship management skills with a track record of building trusted partnerships and delivering measurable business results.
* High emotional intelligence with the ability to navigate complex situations, influence stakeholders, and lead through change.
* Experience working within highly visible client-facing environments where service expectations and attention to detail are exceptionally high.
* Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on operational leadership.
* Strong understanding of workplace hospitality trends, guest engagement strategies, and premium employee experience programs.
* Knowledge of food service operations, culinary programs, labor management, purchasing, inventory controls, and hospitality best practices.
* Proven ability to analyze business performance and develop operational strategies that drive growth, efficiency, and guest satisfaction.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-level relationship-building skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, financial reporting tools, and operational management systems.
* Demonstrated professionalism, executive presence, business maturity, and leadership credibility.
* Passion for hospitality, service excellence, innovation, and creating extraordinary workplace experiences.
